lines.text: Decide going, or decide to go?
Many learners say: I decided going home.
Better: I decided to go home.
After decide, use to plus verb.
To buy! They decided to buy a new car.

data.why: After decide, use to plus verb.
data.aha: Plan, hope and want also take to!
